purpose: Merged, classified inventory of every reference from every consumer into nix-config, so the config/ai -> config/fleet rename (#47) and its straggler sweep (#63) know exactly who breaks. One record per reference.
consumerLayout: nix-config at the repository root; consumer checkouts as siblings (nixos, vps, andoria). Absolute paths are intentionally omitted: see the comment at this key in bin/consumer-inventory.

classificationScheme.rename-now: Reference to the literal config/ai path inside nix-config's own tree; #47 rewrites it in the rename commit.
classificationScheme.stub-covered: External consumer edge resolving through the config/ai subflake (?dir input, its llm-agents follows, its overlays.default use). Recommendation ASSUMES #47 leaves a transitional config/ai->config/fleet stub; if Q4/GAP-DECISIONS declines the stub, reclassify as a coordinated consumer-side URL rename.
classificationScheme.retire: Consumer reach-in into nix-config internal overlay files (${inputs.nix-config}/overlays/*.nix) and the attributes cherry-picked from them; not a supported API (this class broke vulcan at a3cc3843). Delete once the consumer moves to typed config/fleet outputs.
classificationScheme.retain-with-owner: Keep as-is with owner + retirement trigger: the four flake-ai.nix internal imports (GAP-FLAKEAI-INTERNAL), the supported config/*.nix portable surface, root flake=false nix-config inputs, and the ai-nix/node-red/global-Anvil compat surfaces (EPIC 7).

derivation.internalConfigAiRefs: git -C <repo_root> ls-files -z | select tracked *.nix,*.json,*.yml,*.yaml,*.md,*.sh paths; grep -In -F -e 'config/ai' <existing-tracked-files>
derivation.internalConfigAiFiles: derive unique file names from internalConfigAiRefs
derivation.flakeAiInternalConsumers: reuse git-ls-files-scoped tracked paths; grep -In -E -e 'flake-ai\.nix' <existing-tracked-files>  # keep .nix, non-comment, path-import lines
derivation.consumerInputs: parse <consumer>/flake.lock for nodes referencing nix-config (dir='' repo-root input, dir='config/ai' subflake input); locate each url="...nix-config..." line in <consumer>/flake.nix
derivation.consumerReachins: scan every tracked *.nix under <consumer>/ (filesystem fallback if non-Git) for '${inputs.nix-config}/PATH' interpolations, for 'inherit (import "${inputs.nix-config}/...") ATTR ;' cherry-picks, and for 'inputs.nix-config-ai.overlays' uses

Its lock records only portable AI inputs; the root lock remains authoritative for Hera and Clio host configuration.
